title: Note d'Autunno: the 2026 season in Trieste
body:
The European Spirit of Youth Orchestra presents “Note d’autunno dei giovani musicisti europei”, a series of four concerts in Trieste (Italy) from September to December. All concerts start at 20.30 and admission is free.
The season opened on 22 September at Teatro Miela with “Voyage d’un musicien”, featuring the duo Bogdan Sydorenko and Yun-Yang Lee on clarinet and piano. On 14 October, also at Teatro Miela, Ivan Boaro will give a percussion recital titled "Wood Still Says Nothing". On 9 November, the symphony orchestra of the “Davorin Jenko” Music School of Belgrade will bring “Suoni dei Balcani” to Magazzino 26 (Sala Luttazzi). The season will close on 10 December at MIB Trieste School of Management with “Buon Natale in musica”, performed by the ensemble “I Solisti di ESYO”.
author: ESYO Team
